name: Python Syntax Error (Missing Colon)
description: Function header omitting the trailing colon.
expected_finding: SyntaxError: Missing colon at end of function definition header

name: Python Runtime Error (Division by Zero)
description: Averaging numbers where student count can evaluate to zero without guard clause.
code:
total = 500
count = 0
average = total / count
print(average)
expected_finding: ZeroDivisionError: Division by zero crashes the program

name: C++ Off-by-One Loop Condition
description: Loop condition <= 5 on an array of size 5 causing reading out of bounds.
expected_finding: Array index out of bounds: loop condition i <= 5 accesses invalid index 5

name: Java Array Index Out of Bounds
description: Directly accessing index 10 in a Java array initialized with length 5.
expected_finding: ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException: Index 10 out of bounds for length 5

name: Python Infinite Loop (Missing Increment)
description: While loop condition checks counter but counter is never incremented.
code:
i = 1
while (i <= 5):
    print("Number:", i)
    # Missing i += 1
expected_finding: Infinite Loop: counter i is never updated inside the loop body

name: C++ Uninitialized Variable
description: Local summation variable declared without initialization, adding to indeterminate memory.
expected_finding: Uninitialized variable: sum contains garbage memory value before addition

name: Java Missing Recursive Base Case
description: Recursive factorial implementation omitting the termination condition.
expected_finding: StackOverflowError: Missing recursive base case (e.g. n <= 1)

name: Python Logical Accumulator Inversion
description: Subtracting elements when attempting to compute total sum.
code:
numbers = [10, 20, 30]
total = 0
for num in numbers:
    total = total - num
print("Total sum:", total)
expected_finding: Logic error: Subtraction operator used instead of addition in accumulator

name: Python Correct Program
description: Syntactically and logically clean arithmetic utility function.
code:
def add(a, b):
    return a + b

result = add(15, 25)
print("Sum:", result)
expected_finding: No issue detected: Clean, correct program execution

name: Java Null Reference Dereference
description: Invoking string length on an unassigned null object reference.
expected_finding: NullPointerException: Attempting to invoke .length() on null reference
